## Summary

Install a projector lens assembly into an existing halogen headlight housing. [t1036]

## Procedure

2. [Partial] Mount an LED halo ring around the perimeter of the new projector lens.

## Tips & gotchas

- Consider buying new replacement headlight housings instead of using old ones, as the plastic tends to fade and cloud over time. [t1036]
- Apply clear protective film (e.g., Laminix) over the new housing to maintain optical clarity. [t1036]
